g.text: Title: Unit RF board: overview, connectors and crossbar

g.desc: Title: Unit RF board: overview, connectors and crossbar

g.text: RT1 RTD14012F x37, SO-239 Amphenol 83-798 x7, SMA EXP x3, XT60 x2, XT30

g.desc: RT1 RTD14012F x37, SO-239 Amphenol 83-798 x7, SMA EXP x3, XT60 x2, XT30

g.text: Crossbar: rows on L1, columns on L2. Unit 1 = 3 radios x 4 antennas + EXP

g.desc: Crossbar: rows on L1, columns on L2. Unit 1 = 3 radios x 4 antennas + EXP

g.text: JLC0216A, 1.6 mm, 2 layers. RF: coplanar W 2.7 / gap 2.0 mm, about 50 ohm

g.desc: JLC0216A, 1.6 mm, 2 layers. RF: coplanar W 2.7 / gap 2.0 mm, about 50 ohm

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Shack Relay Matrix, unit RF board, architecture rev C. One flat board in a milled 6082-T6 case.

g.desc: Shack Relay Matrix, unit RF board, architecture rev C. One flat board in a milled 6082-T6 case.

g.text: All connectors are on this sheet: radio SO-239 J1 to J3 and EXP SMA J4 to J6 (left), antenna SO-239 J7 to J10

g.desc: All connectors are on this sheet: radio SO-239 J1 to J3 and EXP SMA J4 to J6 (left), antenna SO-239 J7 to J10

g.text: (right), power J11 to J13. Unit 1: 3 radios x 4 antennas; A1 G5RV, A2 RX loop (RX only), A3 and A4 spare.

g.desc: (right), power J11 to J13. Unit 1: 3 radios x 4 antennas; A1 G5RV, A2 RX loop (RX only), A3 and A4 spare.

g.text: Crossbar: the four vertical wires are the antenna columns ANT1 to ANT4 (L2). Each radio sheet holds

g.desc: Crossbar: the four vertical wires are the antenna columns ANT1 to ANT4 (L2). Each radio sheet holds

g.text: a TX row and an RX row (L1) with one relay per column. 37 x RT1: 3 K0, 15 TX, 15 RX, 4 K1.

g.desc: a TX row and an RX row (L1) with one relay per column. 37 x RT1: 3 K0, 15 TX, 15 RX, 4 K1.

g.text: Coil drivers sit next to each relay; Rn_*_DRV and An_K1_DRV are 3.3 V gate inputs from the IO expanders sheet.

g.desc: Coil drivers sit next to each relay; Rn_*_DRV and An_K1_DRV are 3.3 V gate inputs from the IO expanders sheet.

g.text: J14 goes to the controller board (unit 1) or takes the EXP ribbon from the unit 1 controller board (unit 2), D-51, D-53.

g.desc: J14 goes to the controller board (unit 1) or takes the EXP ribbon from the unit 1 controller board (unit 2), D-51, D-53.

g.text: The RF board is the same in both units. K0 follows PTT in hardware (TX_ANY from the controller, D-58).

g.desc: The RF board is the same in both units. K0 follows PTT in hardware (TX_ANY from the controller, D-58).

g.text: Control lines as buses (D-60): R1DRV to R3DRV (coil drives per radio), ANT (K1 drive, detector, bias feed per antenna port),

g.desc: Control lines as buses (D-60): R1DRV to R3DRV (coil drives per radio), ANT (K1 drive, detector, bias feed per antenna port),

g.text: CTRL (I2C, EXP_INT, RLY_EN). One bus segment at each block; the bus alias joins them, each entry wire carries its net name.

g.desc: CTRL (I2C, EXP_INT, RLY_EN). One bus segment at each block; the bus alias joins them, each entry wire carries its net name.

g.text: Test: ERC; netlist check that each ANTk joins 6 row relays and one antenna port; logic verification (verify_logic.py, M-08).

g.desc: Test: ERC; netlist check that each ANTk joins 6 row relays and one antenna port; logic verification (verify_logic.py, M-08).

g.text: Target: 50 ohm RF path, 100 W HF at SWR 3 (173 V peak, 2.45 A rms), PD3 outdoor box.

g.desc: Target: 50 ohm RF path, 100 W HF at SWR 3 (173 V peak, 2.45 A rms), PD3 outdoor box.

g.text: Power entry (top wall): one Amass XT per rail, board side male (PW-M).

g.desc: Power entry (top wall): one Amass XT per rail, board side male (PW-M).

g.text: XT30 on +5V cannot mate with XT60. Pin 1 = GND, pin 2 = + per the KiCad

g.desc: XT30 on +5V cannot mate with XT60. Pin 1 = GND, pin 2 = + per the KiCad

g.text: footprint. OPEN: the vendor STEP puts the angled end on pad 2; convention

g.desc: footprint. OPEN: the vendor STEP puts the angled end on pad 2; convention

g.text: says angled = minus. Check a real part before release.

g.desc: says angled = minus. Check a real part before release.
